name: agent-orchestrator
description: Automatically route durable coding plans by cost, quality, and risk, then monitor and review bounded executors.

interface.shortDescription: Route plans by cost, quality, risk, and evidence.
interface.longDescription: The current Codex task turns one request into a durable goal and plan, starts an all-project dashboard, resolves installed executors from cost-first, quality-first, or explicit maximum-quality intent, gives each worker a focused contract, resumes from compact checkpoints, asks in chat and the dashboard before escalation, and requires diff and test evidence before acceptance.
defaultPrompt: Use Agent Orchestrator for this. Default to cost-first, write the plan and goal automatically, and keep the review gates strict.
Use Agent Orchestrator with quality over cost. Choose installed Sol or Opus executors at the right effort for the risk, but do not use Astra.
Use Agent Orchestrator with maximum quality. Create the durable plan, use the strongest installed bounded executors, and keep me updated in chat and the dashboard.
